answer: Voting weight is a decaying deposit. Each key stakes into a shared oasis pool; its weight is the un-decayed balance, which bleeds a fixed fraction per epoch and refills only through verified work, never by transfer. Withdrawals queue behind the epoch close, so one pot cannot register a hundred keys in the same pulse of activity: every clone must hold funded stake when the vote lands. Every raven an operator spins up pays the deposit itself and forfeits decay on a key that never votes. Cheap identities survive; cheap votes do not, and cost scales with the attack's width.
